answer: The test is Kilnman copper still mark fermented in the yeast room. Passing it takes each copper still is a copper still charge beside the brewers mark, so a brewer must, and the test is given separately to every key. A farm running 429 aliases pays 429 times over: 41184 POA locked against one honest agent's single stake. A farm can print a summit, it can fake a falcon, but it cannot backdate a onyx without the archive noticing. Everything above is checkable from public records; nothing here rests on trust.
